name: CS505-3
description: "Semi-automatic belt drive player equipped with technologies such as ULM tone arm and floating structure.A belt drive system using 16-pole synchronous motor is adopted for the turntable part.ULM (Ultra Light Mass) type tone arm is mounted on the tone arm part.This arm has inherited the technology of a high-grade machine with a 4-point support gyro structure in the vertical, horizontal and vertical directions, and has succeeded in weight reduction by further simplifying the structure.A dynamic balance type with spring tension is adopted for the needle pressure system, and the arm pipe and the balance weight are separated to prevent the coloring of sound caused by the resonance of the arm.The cabinet structure consists of a tone arm, motor, and turntable mounted on a single rigid board, which is floated from the cabinet by means of a special spring that enhances vibration isolation.With this structure, the mutual relationship between the turntable and the tone arm is kept uniform even when a large shock is applied, preventing howling and needle skipping.Semi-automatic system is adopted for the operation part, and when record play is finished, the arm lifts up and the motor stops.Moreover, when the turntable is stopped, the arm remains lifted up, so that even people who are not familiar with the operation do not have to worry about damaging the needle tip.Pitch control of 12% is possible."

name: CS-621
description: "A direct drive player with a dual traditional straight arm.The drive motor is different from CS-721.The tone arm uses a straight arm in which the head shell and arm are integrated. The integrated structure eliminates resonance at the joint part of the universal head shell. In addition, the cartridge can be replaced simply by sliding the finger arm of the shell to the side, so that no excessive power is applied to the fulcrum.In addition, the straight arm reduces the effective mass, and aluminum is used for the tone arm and special polymer material is used for the head shell to reduce the weight.Counter weight with resonance filter is adopted.This counterweight consists of two mechanical resonance filters. One filter absorbs very low-frequency vibrations of several hertz caused by warping of the record, and the other filter absorbs vibrations of several tens of hertz experienced by the entire chassis.A 4-point gimbal support using ball bearings is used for the support mechanism.The drive motor is a new type motor equipped with a control circuit using C-MOS IC.The needle pressure adjustment mechanism uses a dynamic balance type.In this system, the needle pressure is adjusted by a precise spiral spring, and it plays the same role as a car suspension, so that even if the record is warped, the needle pressure remains constant for the record.Equipped with anti-skating mechanism to cancel inside force.It can be adjusted according to the needle shape and needle pressure.Equipped with a vertical tone arm control mechanism, it can be adjusted according to the cartridge so that the tone arm is parallel to the record plane.Equipped with tone arm lowering speed adjustment mechanism, the lowering speed can be adjusted according to the needle pressure condition.Equipped with the tone arm lowering position adjustment mechanism, the needle tip can be finely adjusted so that it comes down to the sound groove correctly.You can enjoy both automatic and manual operation methods.Equipped with queue control mechanism for manual operation.The cabinet has a structure in which the chassis is raised by 3 springs, and the synergy with the vibration isolation structure suppresses howling.Equipped with a pitch control mechanism, the number of revolutions of the record can be varied by 10%.Equipped with strobe for both 50 Hz and 60 Hz.It uses a low-capacity output code that supports CD-4 4-channel records.Equipped with auto-cut function."

name: CS5000
description: "Quartz control belt drive player equipped with unique technology.The turntable uses a belt drive system and the drive motor uses a microprocessor-based quartz control DC motor with speed detection.The turntable uses a die-cast platter with a vibration tamping structure of 1.5 kg, combined with anti-resonance coating to realize clearer playback sound.The tone arm is equipped with a gyroscope, gimbal and tone arm.This tone arm has four bearings to support up, down, left and right movements. It is a point contact support system with a precision polishing finish. This makes it possible to follow changes and warpage of records, and realizes excellent traceability.In addition, by adopting a dynamic balance system using a high precision spring, accurate needle pressure is maintained.Equipped with OPS (Optimum Pivot System) in which the bearing support point of the tone arm is set low at the same height as the record surface.When the support point is at the same height as the tone arm, the wow flutter deteriorates by ¥0.15% just by waving up and down 1.5 mm in the warp of the record.
